name: Simple Keyboard
tagline: A clean, no-frills keyboard with no ads or tracking
description:
Simple Keyboard is an easy, distraction-free keyboard for typing text, numbers, and special characters. It skips the ads, the data collection, and the clutter that many keyboard apps come with, giving you a fast and reliable typing experience.

It's part of the Simple Mobile Tools collection of privacy-respecting, open source Android apps.
